Just reviewed this. Looks great! I noticed I forgot to put an info marker in the design. Do you guys think we should have it for both units of measurement icons?

![Info Marker Turning Circles](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/161098648-b166f221-4486-4fc8-ac7f-1dbc22ab8815.png)
I think we're ok.  For the lower one, it may start with an empty value - so we need to indicate what it represents. For the upper one, the `m` is permanently there.

issues.title: Support turning circles in planned routes
issues.body:
For close-in wargames, the turning circles of ships becomes a significant factor.

* [x] Introduce data-type for turning circle in platform-type
* [x] If turning circle present for platform use "unwind-rope" algorithm to determine extent of achievable positions
* [x] If extent of achievable positions is present, restrict allowable hexes to the current one, plus any cells with a centre in the set of achievable positions
* [x] When player is planning route, exclude those not in the allowable hexes
* [x] When marker is dropped (and turn has been planned), see if it matches the direct route.  If it does, just store ends, otherwise store all cells
* [ ] Respect terrain data - don't allow ships on land, or land assets on sea
* [x] For partial leg plans, ensure correct amount of distance is removed (reflect complex path if present)
* [x] Don't show blue line if it passes through no-go area, and don't process turn if dropped in no-go area.
* [ ] Handle issue when immediately dropping pin into no-go area (see video below)

![scrreencast](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/158978081-edf9803a-2898-4848-9020-f96b966e97c3.gif)

comments.body:
I realise we still need to allow `Turning Circle` to be specified for a `PlatformType` in the admin page/

Here is the field:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/160238954-e764b65d-38d4-45d8-8fd7-7701231bdb04.png)

Here is the editor page for platform-types:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/160239063-963ea44e-cb44-4a52-934f-22ec045e39d8.png)
 
I _guess_ we could introduce a second block in the top row.  It would be titled `Turning circle (optional)`  and  have a single text field, followed by a `m` label to indicate its in units.  On `Save`, if the value is a non-zero number, we store that, else the field is omitted.

Does that sound ok @ShendMikullovci ?

Good idea! Here's how that could look:

![Turning Circles](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/160296283-d39d917c-ab7d-49ba-ae82-b27e1b5bfb4f.png)

![Turning Circles 2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/160296289-edb29925-2eb4-4d37-9546-340b08eae80c.png)

I added the unit text box and measurement icon to maintain uniformity.

> It would be titled Turning circle (optional) and have a single text field, followed by a m label to indicate its in units.

Why the letter "m"?

The value is always in metres.  So, we just show the "m" to the right of the value to remind the Game Designer about this.

There won't be a `trash` icon - since it isn't a list of values.  It's a plain text box, I believe.
Can the user delete if they change their mind?

> The value is always in metres. So, we just show the "m" to the right of the value to remind the Game Designer about this.
> 
> There won't be a `trash` icon - since it isn't a list of values. It's a plain text box, I believe.

Something like this?:

![Turning Circles 2a](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/160400310-4f64c799-c504-425d-a8f2-4b5c92a2ad82.png)
Yes - that's fine. The user will use `delete` key if they change their mind.
